dialog: I'll play with you on MY terms!
You're always a winner if you're having fun!
Let's see how long you last.
Don't give up TOO soon.
You can't possibly beat me.
Are you done? Cause I'm done with you.
Who gave you permission to fly higher than me?
Peons should know better than to defy me!
As you sow/ so shall you reap!
I'll make this simple for you—\n　Move/ or I'll MAKE you!
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
I'm not one for bullying the weak/ but if you insist.
I'll allow you to entertain me.
I'm going to absolutely wreck you.
You're about to taste the dirt!
I can't afford to lose like this!
You're going to make me take this seriously!
A heated battle/ hm?\n　Sounds fun!
Finally/ someone I can afford to cut loose on!
Let's kick this party into high-gear!
I needn't even raise my hand.
Do try to avoid these.
How's this?
Heh heh heh...
Sword of Hisou/ en garde!
Diiiyah!
Come/ let's measure your temperament!
There!
Sword of Hisou...!
Hraaah!
I'll take you down...!
Fool!
If I can grasp their temperament...!
Go/ funnels!
Behold/ my power!
You can't escape!
I'm a master of the keystones...
See if you can handle this!
These are no mere keystones!
Funnels/ attack!
The Way of Heaven lies in my hands!
The Way of Heaven lies in my hands!
This is the power to unveil one's temperament...
This is the power to unveil one's temperament...
Accept it!
Behold/ the power of a celestial!
Sword of Hisou!!
Unveil the temperament/ store it in your body...
Unveil the temperament/ store it in your body...
And release it!
This is the Sword of Hisou's power!
Let's go!
Unveil the temperament of the heavens...!
And upon the scarlet hearts of the people of earth...
Unleash it!
I'm going all out!
This one's gonna be BIG!
Keystone Press...
Keystone Press... Crush!
Impressive/ right?
This'll crush you!
Come forth/ keystone!
Keystone Pressure!
C'mon/ fall already!
Sorry for the trouble.
You're going down!
Come on down/ keystone!
Crush them flat!
Here/ we... go!
Whoops/ I might've overdone it.
These are the feelings everyone entrusted me with!
Now/ grasp their temperaments...
Sword of Hisou!!
Unite the feelings of all humans and youkai/ and...
RELEASE IT!
HAAAAAH!!
Easy peasy.
THIS is how you use the Sword of Hisou...!
Grasp everyone's temperaments...
Sword of Hisou!!
Bind all their hearts to me/ and...
RELEASE IT!
HAAAAAH!!
THAT is my power.
I'll wield this blade/ with my power...!
Calm your spirit...
Sword of Hisou!!
I'll unite everyone's feelings with mine/ and...
RELEASE IT!
TAKE THIIIIS!!
Heh/ no big deal.
I'll let you off the hook/ for now.
I'm so awe-inspiring you didn't dare approach me?\n　Understandable.
Lucky for you I'm so charitable.
Your evil deeds end here!
Having fun? Without ME?
Seems fun/ I'll help out.
Give me a turn/ too.
Be grateful I'm helping!
Honestly/ where would you be without my help?
I'm feeling charitable/ so I'll protect you.
Teamwork? Yes/ yes/ I've heard of it.
You'd better make this count!
I'll go check this out for you.
You'd better not waste my efforts!
Follow my lead!
Excuse me/ why am I stuck behind YOU?
If you screw this up/ I'm taking the lead.
Don't miss my timing!
Come on/ match my temperament!
I'll entrust my burning spirit to my blade!
My temperament is rising...?
That's not like you at all/ Iku!
I'll give you a hand/ Iku!
Don't hog all the fun/ Iku!
Be grateful I'm helping you/ Iku!
Something on your mind/ Iku?
Stay focused/ Iku!
You'd better make this count/ Iku!
Let's take this one down/ Iku!
Why am I stuck behind YOU/ Iku?
Follow me/ Iku!
Iku/ follow my lead!
Me and Iku's temperaments are rising...?
Join me in this blaze of passion/ Iku!
All temperaments shall protect me!
Not a single step back!
Forewarned is forearmed.
How did YOU of all people drive me to this?
I/ umm/ could use a little help here...
I'll admit/ you've got the upper hand here.
You're getting a LITTLE carried away here!
If you wanted to beat me/ now's your best shot!
Pathetic.
Can we even call that a hit?
Do you realize now/ the difference in our power?
Oh/ you don't need to hold back.\n　Come on/ give me your best shot!
Oh/ am I too strong for you? What a shame...
Third-rate/ at best.
You'd best check yourself/ lest you wreck yourself.
Hardly even worth my time.
It would seem you're worth my time.
I'll give your credit for trying/ but...
Ouch. Where are your manners?
Don't you mock me!
Not to worry/ I'm worth at least that much.
I appreciate your enthusiasm.
How'd they get the drop on me...?
Don't go getting cocky yet!
Ngh/ they're pretty serious about this.
You really wanna go/ huh?
Not yet! Give me more!
Now it's getting fun!
You're rather impressive.
Was that just to test the waters?
Well dodged/ if I do say so myself.
Do you take me for a fool?
A good fight is like a conversation. It's just a shame you have nothing interesting to say.
Nothing worth writing home about.
You can't hit me like that!
The fault was yours.
Did you expect me to be an easy target?
Don't let it get you down.
Elegantly avoided!
Alright! That went swimmingly.
I doubt I even need this/ but I'll take it.
I don't even need to move.
A good fight is like a conversation. It's just a shame you have nothing interesting to say.
Oho? You're approaching me?
I make the rules/ understand?
No way/ how could I lose?!
This is humiliating...!
I trust you can all handle the rest/ yes?\n　I'm going to go eat some peaches.
This isn't the best I can do/ okay?!\n　I just got a little distracted this time/ is all!
Playing games is all well and good/\n　but do try to behave yourself.
After I came all the way here/ I won't let you spoil my fun
So/ you caused an incident after all!
What sort of mischief are you up to?
A mindless nightmare is no match for me!
Even I'm not THAT pompous!
You're rather nasty/ aren't you?
Clear the road/ peon!
Her temperament is all mixed up...!
What a foolhardy way of fighting.\n　I'll have to make you quiet down!
Why are you so desperate...?
Come! Show me your temperament!
Very well! I shall resolve this incident!
My temperament shall hold back this torrent of dreams!
I'll unite the temperaments of everyone in Gensokyo!
Come! Show me your temperament!
Very well! I shall resolve this incident!
My temperament shall hold back this torrent of dreams!
I'll unite the temperaments of everyone in Gensokyo!
I'm a celestial/ so this sword should answer my call...!
Sword of Hisou/ let's go!
Sword of Hisou/ let's go!
Heart of scarlet/ reveal the temperaments of all those who live on earth/ and...
Heart of scarlet/ reveal the temperaments of all those who live on earth/ and...
RELEASE IT!
This time/ we'll do it right!
With the power in everyone's hearts...!
Believe in yourself...
Sword of Hisou!!
I'll unite everyone's feelings with mine/ and...
RELEASE IT!
TAKE THIIIIS!!
This is my power!
